heading: IN 1921, THE MOST PROSPEROUS BLACK NEIGHBOURHOOD IN AMERICA WAS BURNED TO THE GROUND. AIRCRAFT WERE USED.
body: On **May 31–June 1, 1921**, a white mob [attacked and burned Greenwood District](red) — known as **"Black Wall Street"** — in [Tulsa, Oklahoma](orange). The district had over **300 Black-owned businesses**. [An estimated 300 people were killed](red). **35 blocks** were destroyed. [Oklahoma National Guard](orange) aircraft flew over the neighbourhood — [survivors reported being shot at from the air](red), though official accounts vary. **$1.8 million in property** was destroyed. No convictions were ever secured. A government commission investigating the massacre was not established until **1997** — **76 years later**.
photo_prompt: 1921 aerial view of Greenwood district Tulsa with smoke rising from burning buildings, documentary historical photography, desaturated with red sky tones, powerful and somber

heading: MOSSAD TRACKED A NAZI WAR CRIMINAL TO ARGENTINA, KIDNAPPED HIM IN THE STREET, AND FLEW HIM TO ISRAEL FOR TRIAL.
body: [Adolf Eichmann](orange) was the [SS](orange) official who organised the logistics of the [Holocaust's mass deportations to death camps](red). After [WW2](orange), he fled to [Argentina](orange) using false documents. In **1960**, a [Mossad](orange) team of **11 agents** tracked him to [Buenos Aires](orange), snatched him from the street outside his home, and smuggled him aboard an [El Al](orange) passenger flight to [Israel](orange) — concealed as a sedated sick passenger. The operation required the personal approval of [Prime Minister David Ben-Gurion](orange). [Eichmann](orange) was tried in [Jerusalem](orange) in **1961**, convicted, and executed in **1962**.
photo_prompt: 1960 Buenos Aires street scene, a dark van parked at the roadside, suited figure barely visible, cold surveillance aesthetic, documentary spy photography, the moment before capture

heading: STREAMING PLATFORMS GENERATE BILLIONS. AN ARTIST NEEDS 1 BILLION STREAMS TO EARN $4,000.
body: [Spotify](orange) pays artists between **$0.003 and $0.005 per stream** — meaning an artist needs approximately **1 billion streams** to earn **$4,000** — before the record label takes its share. [Spotify](orange)'s annual revenue in **2023** was **€13.2 billion**. The royalty structure benefits labels and distributors far more than the artists whose work generates the platform's value. A **2021 House of Commons** inquiry in the [UK](orange) found the system was ["not fit for purpose"](red) and that [most musicians cannot earn a living wage from streaming alone](red). [Spotify](orange) CEO [Daniel Ek](orange) has argued artists need to release music more frequently.
photo_prompt: Close-up of a phone showing a streaming app's play button, in the background a blurred musician performing on stage, the contrast between digital consumption and live creation

heading: FROM 1900s TO 1970s, AUSTRALIA FORCIBLY REMOVED ABORIGINAL CHILDREN FROM THEIR FAMILIES. IT WAS OFFICIAL POLICY.
body: From the **early 1900s** through the **1970s**, [Australian federal and state governments](orange) forcibly removed [Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander](orange) children from their families, placing them in government institutions or with white families. Children were told their parents were dead. Parents were told their children were taken for their welfare. The policy was officially justified as **"assimilation."** An estimated **100,000 children** were removed. The **Bringing Them Home** report (**1997**) confirmed the policy constituted [cultural genocide under international law](red). [Prime Minister Kevin Rudd](orange) issued a formal government apology in **2008**.
photo_prompt: Vast red Australian outback landscape at dusk, a government building silhouette visible in the distance, quiet and contemplative documentary photography, somber gold and red tones

heading: AFTER MUNICH, MOSSAD LAUNCHED A SECRET ASSASSINATION CAMPAIGN TO KILL EVERYONE INVOLVED. IT TOOK YEARS.
body: On **September 5, 1972**, the [Palestinian group Black September](orange) took [11 Israeli Olympic athletes hostage](red) at the [Munich Olympics](orange). All [11 were killed](red) in a failed rescue operation. [Prime Minister Golda Meir](orange) then authorised **Operation WRATH OF GOD** — a covert [Mossad](orange) campaign to systematically assassinate [every person involved in planning the attack](red). The campaign ran for over **20 years**, operating across [Europe](orange), the [Middle East](orange), and [North Africa](orange). In **1973**, Mossad accidentally killed an innocent [Moroccan waiter](orange) in [Norway](orange), having misidentified him — the only acknowledged case of mistaken identity.
photo_prompt: 1972 Munich Olympic village exterior at night, dark and somber atmosphere, distant floodlights casting long shadows, memorial documentary photography aesthetic

heading: IN 2022, A MAJOR WESTERN BANK PLEADED GUILTY TO HELPING A DRUG CARTEL LAUNDER MILLIONS. THEN IT COLLAPSED.
body: In **2022**, [Credit Suisse](orange) became the **first major global bank to plead guilty to a US criminal charge** since [Arthur Andersen](orange) in **2002** — convicted of helping [a Bulgarian cocaine trafficking network](orange) [launder over $600 million](red) through [Swiss](orange) accounts. The case revealed [Credit Suisse](orange) had [failed to prevent money laundering by drug traffickers and sanctioned individuals](red) across multiple investigations spanning years. The bank paid a **$475 million fine**. In **2023**, facing additional scandals, [Credit Suisse](orange) collapsed entirely and was absorbed by rival [UBS](orange) in an emergency takeover arranged by the [Swiss government](orange).
photo_prompt: Credit Suisse building exterior in Zurich at night, imposing corporate architecture, blue-tinted glass, documentary corporate photography, the institutional face of financial crime

heading: CARNEGIE HIRED 300 ARMED DETECTIVES TO BREAK HIS WORKERS' STRIKE. 7 PEOPLE DIED. HE WAS ON HOLIDAY IN SCOTLAND.
body: In **June 1892**, workers at [Carnegie Steel Company's](orange) [Homestead, Pennsylvania](orange) plant went on strike over wage cuts. [Carnegie](orange) left for [Scotland](orange) and handed control to his partner [Henry Clay Frick](orange), who locked the workers out. [Frick](orange) hired **300 Pinkerton Agency** detectives — a private army — to retake the plant by river. A [battle ensued: 7 workers and 3 Pinkertons were killed](red). The [Pennsylvania National Guard](orange) was then called in. The union was broken. [Carnegie](orange) later became famous for philanthropy — donating to libraries and universities while [his own workers couldn't afford basic wages](red).
photo_prompt: 1892 Homestead steel mill at dusk, industrial silhouette, armed figures barely visible at the waterfront, documentary historical illustration style, amber fire light from the furnaces

heading: GERMANY SECRETLY OFFERED MEXICO THREE US STATES IN EXCHANGE FOR ATTACKING AMERICA. BRITAIN INTERCEPTED IT.
body: In **January 1917**, [German Foreign Secretary Arthur Zimmermann](orange) sent a secret telegram to [Mexico](orange) proposing a military alliance: if the [US](orange) entered [WW1](orange), [Germany](orange) would help [Mexico](orange) reclaim **Texas, New Mexico, and Arizona**. [British Naval Intelligence](orange) intercepted and decoded the message. When [Britain](orange) revealed it to the [US](orange), American public outrage helped tip the decision toward entering the war. [President Wilson](orange) declared war on [Germany](orange) in **April 1917** — two months after the telegram was sent. [Zimmermann](orange) uniquely confirmed the telegram was genuine — an admission that helped make the case for war.
photo_prompt: Vintage decoded telegraph message on aged paper, partial text visible, Government code-breaking room 1917, period spy aesthetic, dramatic amber lamp light

heading: NESTLE MARKETED BABY FORMULA IN COUNTRIES WITHOUT CLEAN WATER. THE WHO CODE WAS CREATED BECAUSE OF THEM.
body: In the **1970s**, [Nestle](orange) aggressively marketed infant formula to mothers in [developing countries](orange) using strategies including [dressing sales representatives as nurses](red) and distributing free samples in hospitals. In countries without reliable access to clean water, [formula mixed with contaminated water caused severe infant illness and death](red). The campaign triggered an international boycott. In **1981**, the [WHO](orange) adopted the **International Code of Marketing of Breast-milk Substitutes** — created specifically in response to these practices. [Nestle](orange) was the only company to vote against accepting the [WHO](orange) Code. Investigations in the **2010s and 2020s** found continued violations.
photo_prompt: Baby formula tin on a market shelf beside a mother and infant silhouette, developing country market aesthetic, documentary NGO photography style, stark contrast between corporate packaging and human reality

heading: "WAR IS A RACKET." — THE MOST DECORATED MARINE IN US HISTORY SAID THAT IN 1935. THIS IS WHAT HE MEANT.
body: [Smedley Butler](orange) retired from the [US Marines](orange) in **1931** as the most decorated marine in US history — twice awarded the **Medal of Honor**. In **1935**, he published a book: **"War Is a Racket."** He wrote: **"I spent 33 years in the military being a high-class muscle man for Big Business, Wall Street, and the bankers."** He described his role in securing markets for [Standard Oil](orange) in [China](orange), defending [United Fruit Company](orange) interests in [Central America](orange), and making [Mexico](orange) safe for [American oil interests](orange). He also testified to [Congress](orange) about the **1933 Business Plot** to overthrow [FDR](orange).
photo_prompt: Formal portrait style of a decorated military general in dress uniform, medals visible, somber documentary photography, 1930s aesthetic, the decorated face of a man who changed his views

heading: JAPAN RAN BIOLOGICAL WARFARE EXPERIMENTS ON LIVING PEOPLE. THE US GAVE THE SCIENTISTS IMMUNITY FOR THE DATA.
body: [Unit 731](orange) was a secret [Imperial Japanese Army](orange) biological and chemical warfare research unit that [conducted lethal experiments on prisoners](red) in occupied [Manchuria](orange) from **1935 to 1945**. Experiments included [live vivisection, freezing experiments, pressure chamber tests, and deliberate infection with plague and cholera](red). An estimated [3,000 people](red) were killed. After [WW2](orange), [US](orange) officials secretly [granted immunity to Unit 731 scientists](red) in exchange for their research data. The [Nuremberg](orange) prosecution of German war criminals proceeded, but [no Unit 731 scientist was prosecuted by the US](red).
photo_prompt: Declassified US Army medical intelligence document from the late 1940s, technical diagrams visible beneath redaction marks, documentary evidence photography, cold clinical atmosphere

heading: CHEVRON WAS ORDERED TO PAY $9.5 BILLION FOR AMAZON CONTAMINATION. IT REFUSED. THEN USED US COURTS TO BLOCK IT.
body: From **1964 to 1992**, [Texaco](orange) (later acquired by [Chevron](orange)) extracted oil in [Ecuador's Amazon](orange), leaving behind [oil pits, contaminated water sources, and health impacts on indigenous communities](red). An [Ecuadorian court](orange) in **2011** ordered [Chevron](orange) to pay **$9.5 billion** — later upheld by [Ecuador's Supreme Court](orange). [Chevron](orange) [refused to pay and withdrew all assets from Ecuador](red). It then pursued [New York federal courts](orange) and obtained a ruling blocking [enforcement of the Ecuadorian judgment anywhere in the world](red), based on claims the judgment was obtained through fraud. The **$9.5 billion** has never been paid.
photo_prompt: Aerial view of oil-contaminated Amazon jungle landscape, dark pools visible in the rainforest canopy, documentary environmental photography, powerful and stark

heading: ROCKEFELLER'S COAL COMPANY CALLED THE NATIONAL GUARD ON STRIKING MINERS. 11 CHILDREN WERE KILLED.
body: In **September 1913**, miners at a [Colorado Fuel and Iron Company](orange) mine — owned by [John D. Rockefeller Jr.](orange) — went on strike for safer conditions. They were evicted from company housing and set up a tent colony at [Ludlow](orange). On **April 20, 1914**, the [Colorado National Guard](orange) attacked the colony with rifles and machine guns. [21 people were killed](red): [2 women and 11 children](red) were found suffocated in a pit beneath a burned tent. [Rockefeller](orange) testified before [Congress](orange) that he had not been aware of conditions. The subsequent national outrage led directly to federal labour reform discussions.
photo_prompt: 1914 Ludlow tent colony aftermath, burned canvas tents visible, Colorado landscape, documentary historical photography, somber and damning

heading: MI5 OFFICERS BELIEVED THEIR OWN PRIME MINISTER WAS A SOVIET SPY. SOME PLOTTED TO REMOVE HIM FROM POWER.
body: In the **1970s**, a faction within [MI5](orange) believed [Prime Minister Harold Wilson](orange) was [a Soviet intelligence asset](red). Senior [MI5](orange) officer [Peter Wright](orange) — later the author of **Spycatcher** — claimed a group of officers [mounted destabilisation campaigns against Wilson's government](red), including leaking damaging material to journalists and foreign governments. [Wilson](orange) himself resigned unexpectedly in **1976** and later privately told [BBC](orange) journalists he believed [MI5](orange) had been working against him. A [1988 Cabinet Office](orange) inquiry acknowledged some officers had exceeded their authority but [full details have never been officially released](red).
photo_prompt: UK government building exterior in London fog at night, suited figures barely visible through glass, conspiratorial institutional atmosphere, documentary political photography

heading: PAYDAY LOAN COMPANIES CHARGE 400% ANNUAL INTEREST. LEGALLY. IN 30 US STATES. THEY LOBBIED TO KEEP IT THAT WAY.
body: [Payday loan](orange) companies offer short-term loans with fees that translate to **Annual Percentage Rates of 300-400%**. A two-week loan of **$300** with a **$45 fee** = **391% APR**. Studies show [80% of payday loans are rolled over or renewed within 14 days](red), trapping borrowers in debt cycles. The industry [disproportionately targets low-income communities and communities of colour](red). The [Consumer Financial Protection Bureau](orange) attempted federal rate caps. The industry spent **$13 million lobbying** in **2019-2020** against regulation. **30 states** still have no payday loan rate caps.
photo_prompt: A payday loan store front at night, neon signs glowing, a person's silhouette barely visible through the door, documentary urban photography, the predatory economy made visible

heading: THE GOVERNMENT PROSECUTED, IMPRISONED, AND DEPORTED THE LEADERS OF AMERICA'S LARGEST UNION UNTIL IT COLLAPSED.
body: The [Industrial Workers of the World (IWW)](orange) — the **"Wobblies"** — organised hundreds of thousands of workers across industries by **1917**. During [WW1](orange), the [US government](orange) launched a systematic crackdown: using the **Espionage Act of 1917** to prosecute [IWW](orange) leadership for anti-war speech. In **September 1917**, federal agents raided **48 IWW offices simultaneously** across the country and arrested **165 leaders**. In the **1919-1921 Red Scare**, [foreign-born IWW members were deported](red). The [IWW](orange) was effectively destroyed as a mass organisation. The **Espionage Act** charges from that era are still on the books.
photo_prompt: 1917-era union hall meeting, period workers in hats and suspenders, a speaker at a podium, documentary historical illustration style, dramatic amber light

heading: BRITAIN'S SECRETARY OF STATE FOR WAR WAS SHARING A MISTRESS WITH A SOVIET NAVAL OFFICER.
body: In **1963**, [John Profumo](orange) — [UK Secretary of State for War](orange), with access to [NATO](orange) nuclear defence briefings — was revealed to have been involved with [Christine Keeler](orange), a young woman who was simultaneously involved with [Captain Yevgeny Ivanov](orange), a [Soviet Naval Intelligence](orange) attaché. The extent of any information passed between the relationships was never fully established in [court](orange). [Profumo](orange) lied to the [House of Commons](orange) about his involvement, later admitted it, and resigned. The scandal severely damaged the [Macmillan government](orange) and contributed to the [Conservative Party's](orange) election loss in **1964**.
photo_prompt: 1960s London club interior, suited figures in elegant surroundings, champagne glasses, Cold War-era glamour meets intelligence risk, documentary social photography, amber evening light

heading: THREE COMPANIES LEGALLY SHIPPED 76 BILLION OPIOID PILLS TO 9 STATES. THEY WERE REQUIRED TO FLAG SUSPICIOUS ORDERS.
body: [McKesson](orange), [AmerisourceBergen](orange), and [Cardinal Health](orange) are the three largest pharmaceutical distributors in the US. Between **2006 and 2016**, they shipped **76 billion opioid pills** to [West Virginia, Kentucky, Tennessee, Virginia, Ohio, Alabama, Arkansas, Utah, and Nevada](orange). Under [DEA](orange) regulations, distributors are legally required to [report and refuse suspicious orders](red) — orders that appear to exceed what any pharmacy could legitimately dispense. The distributors [repeatedly failed to do so](red). In **2022**, all three agreed to pay a combined **$21 billion** to settle state and local lawsuits.
photo_prompt: Pharmaceutical distribution warehouse interior, rows of white pill bottles on conveyor belts, clinical cold lighting, the industrial scale of drug distribution made visible

heading: AN 8-STOREY FACTORY COLLAPSED IN 2013. 1,132 WORKERS DIED MAKING WESTERN FASHION. CRACKS WERE REPORTED THE DAY BEFORE.
body: On **April 23, 2013**, structural cracks were discovered in the [Rana Plaza](orange) building in [Dhaka, Bangladesh](orange). Banks and shops on lower floors **closed for safety reasons**. [Garment workers on upper floors were told to return to work anyway](red) — suppliers reportedly faced penalties for missed delivery deadlines. On **April 24th**, the **8-storey building collapsed**. [1,132 people were killed](red). At least **2,500 were injured**. The building housed factories supplying clothes to [Primark](orange), [Mango](orange), [Walmart](orange), and other Western retailers. The [Bangladesh Accord on Fire and Building Safety](orange) was created in direct response.
photo_prompt: Textile factory workers at sewing machines in a densely packed floor, overhead fluorescent lighting, documentary photojournalism aesthetic, the human scale of fast fashion production

heading: THE CIA AND SOVIET KGB WERE SIMULTANEOUSLY FUNDING OPPOSITE SIDES OF THE SAME CIVIL WAR IN AFRICA.
body: When [Angola](orange) became independent from [Portugal](orange) in **November 1975**, three competing factions immediately fought for control. The [CIA](orange) covertly funded and armed the [FNLA](orange) and [UNITA](orange) factions under **Operation FEATURE**. The [Soviet Union](orange) funded the [MPLA](orange) and arranged for [Cuban troops](orange) to deploy. [Congress](orange) passed the **Clark Amendment** in **1975** specifically prohibiting [US military involvement in Angola](orange) after the operation became known. Declassified documents show the [CIA](orange) had deployed **$32 million** and the [KGB](orange) had deployed significant support — both [without the knowledge of most of their own governments' citizens](red).
photo_prompt: 1970s African savannah landscape with military equipment barely visible in the background, documentary Cold War military photography, dry landscape, distant conflict

heading: THE NFL FUNDED ITS OWN CONCUSSION RESEARCH. IT DENIED CTE EVIDENCE. INTERNAL COMMUNICATIONS TOLD A DIFFERENT STORY.
body: From **1994 to 2009**, the [NFL](orange) ran its own **Mild Traumatic Brain Injury Committee**, which [repeatedly published research denying a link between football and long-term brain damage](red), despite [neuropathologist Dr. Bennet Omalu](orange) publishing peer-reviewed research in **2005** linking football to [Chronic Traumatic Encephalopathy (CTE)](orange). Internal [House of Representatives](orange) correspondence revealed in **2009** showed [NFL](orange) officials were [aware of CTE risks while publicly disputing them](red). The [NFL](orange) settled a class-action lawsuit with **20,000 former players** for **$1 billion** in **2015**, without admitting liability.
photo_prompt: Football helmet in extreme close-up, a single crack in the shell visible, dark background, stark documentary product photography, the visible and invisible damage of contact sport

heading: "KILL THE INDIAN, SAVE THE MAN" — THE US GOVERNMENT'S OFFICIAL APPROACH TO NATIVE AMERICAN CHILDREN.
body: [Carlisle Indian Industrial School](orange) in [Pennsylvania](orange) was founded in **1879** by [Captain Richard Henry Pratt](orange), who coined the phrase: **"Kill the Indian in him, and save the man."** The school — funded by the [US federal government](orange) — was the model for a nationwide network of **408 boarding schools** that forcibly separated [Native American](orange) children from their families, [banned Indigenous languages and ceremonies](red), and forced assimilation through English education and Christian religion. A **2022 US Interior Department report** documented [53 burial sites near these schools](red) and confirmed [children died in the schools](red) and were buried far from their families.
photo_prompt: Historical black and white photo style: a US government boarding school building, formal exterior, children barely visible, the institutional face of cultural erasure, documentary historical photography

heading: THE WHITE HOUSE SOLD ARMS TO IRAN UNDER AN EMBARGO. FUNNELED THE MONEY TO REBEL FIGHTERS. THEN SHREDDED THE DOCUMENTS.
body: In **1986**, it was revealed that senior [White House](orange) officials — including [National Security Council](orange) aide [Oliver North](orange) — had secretly sold [weapons to Iran](red), which was under a **US arms embargo**, and [diverted the profits to fund Contra rebels in Nicaragua](red) — a funding mechanism [Congress](orange) had explicitly prohibited. When investigators arrived, [North](orange) and his secretary [shredded thousands of documents](red). [North](orange) was convicted on **three counts** in **1989** but the convictions were vacated on appeal due to immunity deals. [President Reagan](orange) said he had no knowledge of the diversion. **11 officials were convicted**, and **6 were later pardoned** by [President George H.W. Bush](orange).
photo_prompt: 1986 White House situation room, a shredder visible in one corner, classified documents on a table, dramatic late-night office lighting, documentary political crisis photography

heading: NAVIENT WAS PAID TO HELP STUDENT LOAN BORROWERS. IT WAS STEERING THEM INTO MORE EXPENSIVE OPTIONS INSTEAD.
body: [Navient](orange) — spun off from [Sallie Mae](orange) in **2014** — serviced **$300 billion** in federal and private student loans for **12 million borrowers**. In **2017**, the [Consumer Financial Protection Bureau](orange) sued [Navient](orange), alleging it [systematically steered borrowers away from income-driven repayment programmes](red) — which would have lowered monthly payments — and into [forbearance plans that cost more long-term](red), because the processing was simpler for the company. In **2022**, [Navient](orange) reached a **$1.85 billion settlement** with **39 state attorneys general** and cancelled **$1.7 billion in private student loans**. [Navient](orange) did not admit wrongdoing.
photo_prompt: Stack of student loan documents on a desk beside a university diploma, dramatic spotlight, the debt burden visualised through paper, documentary financial photography

heading: US SOLDIERS WERE ORDERED TO WATCH NUCLEAR BOMB TESTS FROM TRENCHES. THEN TOLD NEVER TO SPEAK OF IT.
body: Between **1945 and 1963**, approximately **400,000 US military personnel** were present at nuclear tests in [Nevada](orange), the [Pacific](orange), and [elsewhere](orange) — often positioned in [trenches a few miles from detonation sites](red) to test how infantry could operate after nuclear exchange. Many were ordered to [march into the blast area immediately after detonation](red). They were told radiation exposure was minimal. Veterans later reported [unusually high rates of cancer](red). Many were told under the **Atomic Energy Act** they [could face prosecution for discussing their exposure](red). Congress only formally recognised these veterans and created a compensation programme in **1988**.
photo_prompt: 1950s Nevada nuclear test desert landscape, a distant mushroom cloud rising on the horizon, soldiers silhouetted in the foreground watching from a trench, documentary military history photography

heading: IN 1983, NATO WAR GAMES WERE SO REALISTIC THAT SOVIET FORCES WENT TO NUCLEAR ALERT. NOBODY IN THE WEST KNEW.
body: In **November 1983**, [NATO](orange) conducted **Able Archer 83** — a military exercise simulating escalation to nuclear warfare. Soviet intelligence interpreted the exercises as a possible cover for a real [US](orange) first strike. [Soviet nuclear forces](orange) in [Eastern Europe](orange) [were placed on heightened alert](red). [Soviet](orange) aircraft armed with nuclear weapons were prepared for immediate launch. The crisis passed when the exercises ended. [President Reagan](orange) only learned how close the situation came in **1984** when a [CIA](orange) report was declassified. A **2015 UK government report** concluded the world had come **"closer to nuclear war than was realised at the time."**
photo_prompt: Cold War-era military command bunker interior, radar screens glowing green, uniformed figures at consoles, tension visible in posture, dramatic cold blue and red lighting, documentary military photography

heading: DRUG COMPANIES EXTEND THEIR PATENT MONOPOLIES FOR DECADES BY MAKING MINOR CHANGES. ONE INSULIN WAS MODIFIED 74 TIMES.
body: Under US patent law, pharmaceutical companies can [reset their patent clock](red) by making minor modifications to existing drugs — a practice known as **"evergreening."** Modifications can include: a new delivery mechanism, a slightly different molecular form, or a new dosage. [I-MAK](orange) analysis found one insulin product underwent **74 reformulations** over its patent lifetime. The net effect: [generic competitors are blocked from entering the market for decades beyond the original 20-year patent term](red). The [Federal Trade Commission](orange) has identified evergreening as a primary driver of drug price inflation in the US. **Over 70%** of the drugs most commonly prescribed were reformulations of existing products.
photo_prompt: Timeline infographic style: a single drug molecule diagram extending across decades of patent protection, each minor reformulation marked with a green check, a growing price curve underneath

heading: A "COMPLETELY SAFE" MORNING SICKNESS DRUG CAUSED BIRTH DEFECTS IN OVER 10,000 CHILDREN WORLDWIDE.
body: In the late **1950s**, the drug [Thalidomide](orange) was marketed across [Europe, Canada, Australia,](orange) and dozens of other countries as a safe treatment for morning sickness and insomnia in pregnant women. The manufacturer, [Grünenthal](orange), advertised it as **"completely safe."** It caused severe limb and organ malformations in an estimated **10,000 to 20,000 children** worldwide, with thousands more miscarried. In the [US](orange), [FDA](orange) medical officer [Dr. Frances Kelsey](orange) repeatedly refused to approve the drug, citing insufficient safety data — a decision that [spared the US from the scale of the crisis seen elsewhere](red). The disaster directly led to the **1962 Kefauver-Harris Amendment**, which created modern US drug safety and efficacy testing requirements.
photo_prompt: 1960s pharmaceutical bottle on a clinical white surface, soft documentary medical photography, somber and clinical, a single prescription pad visible in soft focus background
